title: Mindat Language (MMF) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Mindat is an endangered indigenous language of Nigeria. It belongs to the Afro-Asiatic language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
